name: extract-regex-no-match
description: extract fails when the regular expression does not match the resolved value, naming the path and the pattern.
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: regex miss
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- capture: "GET /message as: msg"
- extract:
    from: msg
    values:
      code:
        path: $.body.text
        regex: "\\b(\\d{6})\\b"
